description: Calls DELETE /v1/templates/{templateId}. This is a soft delete: the template's `status` is set to "archived" (it is not erased from storage), and the call returns the resulting archived template record. Archived templates are excluded from jsonfabrica_list_templates by default — pass `status: "archived"` there to find them again — and both jsonfabrica_get_template and jsonfabrica_generate_from_template still work against the id afterwards, since archiving does not block reads or generation. Use this when a template should stop showing up in normal listings; there is currently no tool to restore an archived template back to `active`.

templateId.description: ID of the template to delete. Required.
